name: Cleaver, Hewer of Suffering

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Hemorrhaging
effects.tooltip: Hemorrhaging : This weapon is viciously sharp and will do an additional 2 to 16 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.

effects.name: Limb Chopper
effects.tooltip: Limb Chopper : This potent and feared ability allows the weapon to sever the limbs of those it strikes. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit, the weapon severs an opponent's limb from its body. Some creatures, including many aberrations and all oozes , have no limbs. Others, such as golems and undead creatures, are not affected by the loss of their limbs. Most other creatures, however, have their movement slowed 75% and attacks slowed by 50% when a limb is cut off.

effects.name: Improved Cursespewing
effects.tooltip: Improved Cursespewing : On Vorpal Hit : Your enemy is cursed with a -4 morale penalty on attack rolls , saving throws , and skill checks . This painful curse also causes the victim to take 2d6 damage every two seconds for a duration of twelve seconds. Additional vorpal strikes while the curse is active will extend the duration by another twelve seconds.

effects.name: Doublestrike
effects.tooltip: Doublestrike 6% : Passive: 6% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
